continuation_gate.rule: BOTH C2 seeds: raw qualified and >=2% RMS gain in BOTH measurements on >=8/16 overall and >=2/4 internal check

statistics: Per-object ratios then median; two fresh MC seeds are measurement repeats, not new independent objects.

record.gate_rationale: All actual training initializations and every original CPU path pass; old original A GPU stress limitations retained and original A is not used to initialize this continuation.
record.final_authority: unchanged original CPU deployment plus exact endpoint audit
record.final_required_diagnostic: all six final weights x16 GPU mirror vs original CPU, preserving discrepancies and never choosing checkpoints

correctness_scope.meaning: Scoped gates and final discrepancies retained separately; never promoted to global PASS.
